name: Dangerous Command Guard
description: Intercepts tool calls before they run and blocks destructive commands like rm -rf along with reads of .env files that hold secrets.

name: Ruff Validator
description: Lints every Python file Claude writes with ruff check and blocks with the lint output so Claude fixes the errors.

name: Type Check Validator
description: Runs Astral's ty type checker on each file after a write and feeds type errors back to Claude to retry.

name: TTS Completion Announcer
description: Speaks a short spoken message when Claude finishes responding, using ElevenLabs, OpenAI, or offline pyttsx3 voices.

name: Subagent Completion Announcer
description: Summarizes what a finished subagent did and reads it aloud, queueing voices so parallel agents don't talk over each other.

name: Session Context Loader
description: Injects the current git branch, uncommitted change count, TODO files, and open GitHub issues at the start of every session.

name: Transcript Backup
description: Copies the session transcript to a timestamped JSONL backup before the conversation is compacted, so no history is lost.

name: Permission Auditor
description: Logs every permission dialog and auto-approves read-only tools such as Read, Grep, git status, and ls.

name: Attention Sound
description: Plays an audio alert, or speaks aloud on macOS, whenever your agent is waiting on you for input.
